grammatical analysis: an original extract of about 120 words (a news report) written into the prompt; analyse its voice, tense or modality and its sentence structures, with evidence and effect

grammatical analysis: an original extract of about 120 words (a first-person narrative) written into the prompt; analyse its voice, tense or modality and its sentence structures, with evidence and effect
text-level analysis: an original text of about 150 words (a short speech) written into the prompt; analyse its structure, perspective, rhetoric and tone, with evidence and effect
